title: Senior Software Engineer
description: In my previous career, I worked across industries, growing my skill set until I became a full-stack (server to fronted) senior software engineer with significant project oversight. I was ready for a career change, but I still very much enjoy coding and problem solving! Here I'll highlight a few projects I'm proud to have worked on over the years.
duties: Technology: Too much to list! Enduring favorites: Python, Jupyter Notebooks, Typescript, HTML/CSS, SQL, React, and Git

Fair Neuroimaging Lab: I built a Python pipeline wrapper to run the Human Connectome Pipeline for processing fMRI data on the OHSU HPC cluster. This pipeline was able to automatically resubmit jobs when they failed unexpectedly.

Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center: I developed a visualization tool in D3.js that was used by nurses in a pilot study for proactive care for chemo patients who reported worsening symptoms in daily web-based surveys. This pilot showed a significant reduction in ER visits by chemo patients following treatment!
Janelia Research Institute: I maintained a visualization tool that was used to evaluate data quality of automated neuroimaging data segmentation using Three.js
Primary Kids: as part of a small team, overhauled an entire e-commerce site to reach full accessability compliance for visually-impaired users
